text:
𝗭𝗜𝗠𝗕𝗔𝗕𝗪𝗘 𝗪𝗜𝗡 𝗦𝗘𝗥𝗜𝗘𝗦! 🇿🇼🔥

Beat Afghanistan by 57 runs in Sharjah, chasing 418 fell short.
Naseer Maroofkhil hit 101*; Muzarabani took 6 wkts.

Zim's first multi-Test series win since 2004 👏

#AFGvZIM #Cricket

facebook.caption:
𝗭𝗜𝗠𝗕𝗔𝗕𝗪𝗘 𝗡𝗘 𝗝𝗘𝗘𝗧𝗜 𝗦𝗘𝗥𝗜𝗘𝗦! 🇿🇼🔥

👉 Sharjah Test mein Zimbabwe ne Afghanistan ko 57 run se haraya
👉 418 ka target tha, Afghanistan 57 run door reh gaya
👉 Naseer Maroofkhil ka debut series mein 101* naabad, magar team nahi bachi
👉 Muzarabani: 6 wicket + half-century, Player of the Match
👉 2004 ke baad Zim ki pehli multi-Test series jeet

Kya Afghanistan ko wapas aana chahiye? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #AFGvZIM #Zimbabwe
